description: This file defines a base class for managing server processes used in layout tests, including starting, stopping, port checking, and error handling.

classes.name: ServerError
classes.description: Custom exception class for server-related errors.

classes.name: ServerBase
classes.description: A skeleton class for starting and stopping servers used by layout tests, providing common functionality for server process management.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the server, handling stale processes and port availability, raising ServerError if startup fails.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the server process if running, handling pid files and process termination.

methods.name: _prepare_config
methods.description: Placeholder for subclasses to override for server configuration before start.

methods.name: _remove_stale_logs
methods.description: Removes old log files; can be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: _spawn_process
methods.description: Creates and starts the server process, returning its pid.

methods.name: _check_and_kill
methods.description: Checks if the process is running and kills it if so.

methods.name: _remove_pid_file
methods.description: Removes the pid file if it exists.

methods.name: _remove_log_files
methods.description: Removes log files starting with a specific prefix.

methods.name: _log_errors_from_subprocess
methods.description: Logs errors from the subprocess and error logs.

methods.name: _wait_for_action
methods.description: Repeatedly performs an action until success or timeout.

methods.name: _is_server_running_on_all_ports
methods.description: Checks if server is active on all specified ports.

methods.name: _check_that_all_ports_are_available
methods.description: Verifies that all required ports are free before starting.
